headline: Qualcomm Shares Fall as Weak Smartphone Chip Sales Offset Data-Center Growth
summary: Qualcomm shares declined as weak smartphone chip sales overshadowed the company's momentum in the data-center segment.
why: Qualcomm is a dominant supplier of mobile processors. Its results are a key indicator of the health of the global smartphone market and the company's diversification into AI and data centers.

impacts.name: Qualcomm
impacts.why: Weak smartphone chip sales negatively impacted investor sentiment.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Smartphone chip sales remain a significant portion of Qualcomm's revenue; weakness here outweighs growth in newer segments.
